'''Blade Three''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Coalition]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Along with [[Nilloc]] and [[Vegg]], they were present in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] when it was [[Battle of Tolea Biqua|attacked]] by the [[Cularin Militia]].
